inlinePayload.name: search_knowledge
inlinePayload.description: Search reference knowledge: HSDS 3.2.3 objects and required fields, conversion rules, One Degree docs, the verification/discovery skill. Use before building HSDS or when unsure what a field or category means.

inlinePayload.name: translate_text
inlinePayload.description: Translate text (Amazon Translate), e.g. a Spanish-only page or flyer, before comparing facts. source_language defaults to auto-detect, target_language to en.

inlinePayload.name: send_message
inlinePayload.description: Alert the specialist team (email or sms) about an urgent problem: a facility that appears permanently closed, unsafe or fraudulent. Recipients are fixed by the operator. At most one message per job.
